records.issue_text: Setting tabIndex={-1} on the password-visibility button in packages/ui/components/form/inputs/Input.tsx:49 removes it from keyboard navigation, preventing keyboard-only users from operating it.
records.rationale: The diff clearly shows tabIndex={-1} being added to the password visibility toggle button at line 49 in packages/ui/components/form/inputs/Input.tsx. This attribute removes the button from the tab order, which means keyboard-only users cannot focus on or activate this button using keyboard navigation. This is a real accessibility defect introduced by this change.
